name: Redemption Multiple Order 07
definition: Instruction from an investor to sell investment fund units back to the fund.

MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a group of individual orders, as assigned by the instructing party. This identifier links the individual orders together.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Market in which the advised trade transaction was executed.

OrderDateTime.name: Order Date Time
OrderDateTime.definition: Date and time the order is placed by the investor or its agent.

ExpiryDateTime.name: Expiry Date Time
ExpiryDateTime.definition: Date on which the order expires.

RequestedFutureTradeDate.name: Requested Future Trade Date
RequestedFutureTradeDate.definition: Future date at which the investor requests the order to be executed.|The specification of a requested future trade date is not allowed in some markets. The date must be a date in the future.

CancellationRight.name: Cancellation Right
CancellationRight.definition: Cancellation right of the investor with respect to the investment fund order.

InvestmentAccountDetails.name: Investment Account Details
InvestmentAccountDetails.definition: Account impacted by the investment fund order.

IndividualOrderDetails.name: Individual Order Details
IndividualOrderDetails.definition: Instruction from an investor to sell investment fund units back to the fund.

BulkCashSettlementDetails.name: Bulk Cash Settlement Details
BulkCashSettlementDetails.definition: Payment process for the transfer of cash from the debtor to the creditor.

TotalSettlementAmount.name: Total Settlement Amount
TotalSettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money paid /to be paid or received in exchange for the financial instrument in the multiple order.

BulkCashSettlementDetailsRule.definition: Either one or more occurrences of IndividualOrderDetails/CashSettlementDetails or BulkCashSettlementDetails may be present, but not both.

SettlementCurrencyRule.definition: If BulkCashSettlementDetails is present, then Currency in IndividualOrderDetails/SettlementAmount, if present, must be the same in all occurrences of IndividualOrderDetails.

OrderOriginatorEligibility3Rule.definition: Either InvestmentAccountDetails/OrderOriginatorEligibility or one or more occurrences of IndividualOrderDetails/RelatedPartyDetails/OrderOriginatorEligibility may be present, but not both.

TotalSettlementCurrencyRule.definition: If TotalSettlementAmount is present, then Currency in IndividualOrderDetails/SettlementAmount, if present, must be the same in all occurrences of IndividualOrderDetails.
